title: Pebble Beach · Original Data
summary: Play all 18 holes of Pebble Beach on the original PGA Tour 2005 course geometry, textures, tees and pins, decoded locally from your own disc images. Ball physics, rules and the golfer are approximate native development code.
notes: This is a native development prototype, not Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2005 or a verified port.
Original per-hole terrain, materials, championship tees (index 3) and first pin positions come from the local PBL course files. Run python3 Tools/prepare_pga2005.py once to prepare them.

Lies come from original surface flags. Ball flight, bounce, rolling, penalties and drops are approximate native rules until the original physics are reconstructed. Original vegetation, golfer, audio and modes are not included yet.
Course-condition variant layers use a development default; the original selection rule is still being recovered.
Rounds save when paused, between holes and on exit, and resume only onto identical course data.
Performance on the required M1 MacBook Air at 2560 × 1600 has not been measured for this module yet.
keyboard: Left / Right or A / D: aim. Up / Down or W / S: choose club. H: aim at pin.
Space / Return or click: start swing, set power, set accuracy. Drag horizontally: aim. Scroll: zoom.
C: switch camera. Escape: cancel swing, then pause. R: restart hole while stationary or paused. F: fullscreen.
controller: A: swing / resume / advance. Left stick or D-pad left/right: aim. LB / RB or D-pad up/down: choose club.
Y: aim at pin (when paused: restart hole). X: switch camera. Right stick up/down: zoom. B: cancel / pause. Menu: pause.
